articles.title: How to drive transformations with rigor
articles.summary: McKinsey research finds that companies executing transformations with rigor are much more likely to meet overall organizational transformation goals. Chris Hagedorn, Preeya Mody, and Michel Morenville join us to discuss what rigor really means in the context of transformation and how to embed it throughout the process, from setting the aspiration, to mobilization, to delivering impact.

articles.title: Author Talks: Can you fulfill your ambition and compose a life?
articles.summary: Mayfield’s former Chief Marketing Officer Kamini Ramani draws on Indian women leaders’ experiences in corporate America to bring a culturally rooted lens to ambition, resilience, and leadership.

articles.title: Workforce in motion: Skills and pathways to future jobs in the United States
articles.summary: AI, automation, and broader structural trends are accelerating the reallocation of work across the US economy. Capturing its benefits requires developing new professional pathways and skills, and reducing barriers between declining and growing occupations.

articles.title: The next phase of government AI economics
articles.summary: Subsidized AI pilots are expiring as usage explodes. Here’s how US public sector leaders can treat AI spend as a managed category before the bill arrives.

articles.title: Make life better: Mikhail Lomtadze’s customer-first philosophy
articles.summary: Mikhail Lomtadze, cofounder and CEO of Kaspi, believes the only measure that matters is whether Kaspi makes customers’ lives better or not—and why that single conviction changes everything else.
